high_level_description: This image shows the storefront of a business named "Shepherd Gents Saloon." The sign is illuminated with bright white and blue lights, making it stand out against the darker background of the building. The sign features a stylized logo on the left side, which appears to be a sheep's head, reinforcing the name "Shepherd." The storefront has a modern design with a clean, white facade. Above the entrance, there are several small, round lights that provide additional illumination.
